title.en: Interleave the two ends of a list
title.es: Intercalar los dos extremos de una lista

prompt.en:
Write `fold_list(head)`: reorder a singly linked list in place so it alternates between its front and its back: first node, last node, second node, second-to-last node, and so on. `1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5` becomes `1 → 5 → 2 → 4 → 3`. The first node stays first, so return nothing. Each `ListNode` has `val` and `next`.

Move the nodes instead of rewriting their values, in O(n) time and O(1) extra memory (no list of nodes).

The tests call the provided `run_fold_list(values)`, which builds the list from `values`, calls your function and returns the values from the original first node onwards.
prompt.es:
Escribe `fold_list(head)`: reordena in-place una lista enlazada simple para que alterne entre su inicio y su final: primer nodo, último nodo, segundo nodo, penúltimo nodo, y así. `1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5` queda `1 → 5 → 2 → 4 → 3`. El primer nodo sigue siendo el primero, así que no devuelvas nada. Cada `ListNode` tiene `val` y `next`.

Mueve los nodos en vez de reescribir sus valores, en O(n) de tiempo y O(1) de memoria extra (sin una lista de nodos).

Los tests llaman a `run_fold_list(values)`, ya incluida: construye la lista a partir de `values`, llama a tu función y devuelve los valores desde el primer nodo original en adelante.

hints.en: It is three small problems in a row: find the middle, reverse the second half, then weave the two halves together.
hints.es: Son tres problemas pequeños seguidos: encuentra el medio, invierte la segunda mitad y luego entrelaza las dos mitades.

hints.en: Stop `slow` on the last node of the first half and cut there (`slow.next = None`); otherwise the halves stay joined and the weave ends in a cycle.
hints.es: Deja `slow` en el último nodo de la primera mitad y corta ahí (`slow.next = None`); si no, las mitades siguen unidas y el entrelazado termina en un ciclo.

hints.en: Weave by taking one node from each half in turn, saving both `next` pointers before re-linking. The reversed half is never longer, so loop while it has nodes.
hints.es: Entrelaza tomando un nodo de cada mitad por turno, guardando ambos `next` antes de reconectar. La mitad invertida nunca es más larga, así que itera mientras tenga nodos.

solution:
# --- your code ---
def fold_list(head: "ListNode | None") -> None:
    if head is None:
        return
    slow = fast = head
    while fast.next is not None and fast.next.next is not None:
        slow = slow.next                 # ends on the last node of the first half
        fast = fast.next.next
    back, slow.next = slow.next, None    # cut the list in two
    prev = None
    while back is not None:              # reverse the second half
        nxt = back.next
        back.next = prev
        prev, back = back, nxt
    front, back = head, prev
    while back is not None:              # weave: one node from the front, one from the back
        front_next, back_next = front.next, back.next
        front.next = back
        back.next = front_next
        front, back = front_next, back_next


# --- provided: do not edit ---
class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


def build_list(values: list[int]) -> ListNode | None:
    head = None
    for v in reversed(values):
        head = ListNode(v, head)
    return head


def to_nodes(head: ListNode | None, limit: int) -> list[ListNode]:
    out = []
    while head is not None:
        if len(out) == limit:
            raise ValueError("the result has more nodes than the input: is there a cycle?")
        out.append(head)
        head = head.next
    return out


def run_fold_list(values: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    head = build_list(values)
    given = to_nodes(head, len(values))
    try:
        fold_list(head)
        if any(n.val != v for n, v in zip(given, values)):
            raise ValueError("move the nodes, not their values: every node must keep its value")
        return [n.val for n in to_nodes(head, len(values))]
    finally:
        for n in given:                  # free node by node: a long chain freed at once overflows Pyodide's stack
            n.next = None

explain.en: The back half is visited backwards, and a singly linked list only goes forwards, so reverse that half first. Fast/slow pointers find the end of the first half in one pass; cutting there and reversing the rest leaves two forward lists (`1 → 2 → 3` and `5 → 4`) to weave one node at a time. Each step is O(n) time and O(1) memory. The trap is the brute force: walking to the tail again for every node is O(n²).
explain.es: La mitad de atrás se visita al revés, y una lista simple solo avanza hacia adelante, así que primero invierte esa mitad. Los punteros fast/slow encuentran el final de la primera mitad en una pasada; cortar ahí e invertir el resto deja dos listas hacia adelante (`1 → 2 → 3` y `5 → 4`) para entrelazar de a un nodo. Cada paso es O(n) en tiempo y O(1) de memoria. La trampa es la fuerza bruta: volver a caminar hasta la cola por cada nodo es O(n²).
